product_updates.content: OpenAI said that ChatGPT free and Go users are also getting a new think button for complex queries.

product_updates.content: Taking vibe-coding a step further, Naïve claims its infra can automate most of the work in setting up and running a business.

product_updates.title: Gen Z dating apps like Ditto ditch swiping in favor of AI matchmaking
product_updates.content: This generation of twentysomethings is so disillusioned with swipe-based dating apps that they'll try literally anything else — even an AI matchmaker.

product_updates.title: Amid legal battles, Suno says it will start watermarking songs
product_updates.content: Suno's watermarking feature comes as the company is fighting legal battles on several fronts.

product_updates.title: Ex-Spotify employees raise $10M to bring the AI behind its recommendations to e-commerce
product_updates.content: The startup's platform predicts which product a shopper wants next, learns their general taste, and fine-tunes continuously based on what they do in real time.

product_updates.title: Exclusive: Mirendil inks $100M+ Google Cloud deal to scale self-improving AI
product_updates.content: Mirendil has signed a $100 million-plus Google Cloud partnership to expand its compute infrastructure, powering research into self-improving AI systems designed to accelerate scientific discovery and AI development.

product_updates.title: Google Maps adds agentic features, including food ordering and hotel bookings
product_updates.content: The launch of these new features reflects Google’s ambitions to transform Google Maps from a navigation tool into an assistant that's capable of helping users complete real-world tasks.

product_updates.title: Omilia raises $67M to scale its customer support platform
product_updates.content: The Series B is the company's second fundraise since it last raised capital in 2020. In that time, it has increased its ARR by 10x to $60 million.
